Root landing and remembered entry are implemented and exercised in Chromium. Production deployment is pending.

Web, TV and phone introductions exist. Phone Developer Options can open isolated sample screens. The phone has sample-only capture and share. Native runtime checks and matching platform screenshots remain open.
Expo supports a deployment endpoint and an isolated temporary developer switcher. Native TV host configuration, end-to-end custom peer tests and native verification of saved presets remain open.

Stable native downloads, PWA installation entry and alternative-store links are implemented. Official image badges are wired into the landing page and README. Platform installation and deployed link verification remain open.
Native validation and distribution jobs exist. Release screenshot refresh and commit-derived public notes need verification or implementation.

Trust-boundary checks exist. Security scans need CI results and dependency remediation where applicable.
Existing artifacts are checked and publication is separated from source builds. Full publication receipts and partial-release recovery automation remain open.
Runbooks and health probes describe operations. Alert delivery and recovery objectives need production verification.
